title: CriticReview
description: ADR-025 structured output of the parameterized critic harness and of interface-scoped cross-review. Objections must carry severity + evidence; a 'no_material_objections' verdict is valid ONLY with a completed verification checklist (anti-sycophancy). Cross-review objections must tag the interface assumption they attack — out-of-domain objections are dropped by the orchestrator.

role.description: critic = parameterized adversarial harness; cross_review = the other field's expert reviewing interface assumptions.

field.description: Domain knowledge composed into the reviewer, e.g. quant_trading | ml_data_scientist.

target_claim.description: The specific claim/omission attacked — quote or pinpoint it.

severity.description: blocker/major = material (forces a revision round); minor = advisory.

kind.description: over_hedging = load-bearing conclusions left uncommitted/all-provisional; unexplored_concept = a field-relevant concept the author's retrieval trace never researched (forces a fresh, tool-enabled research round); out_of_domain marks an objection outside the reviewer's scope — recorded but dropped.

evidence.description: What grounds the objection: retrieval hits, citation-check results, counter-evidence.

interface_assumption.description: cross_review ONLY: the interface assumption attacked (e.g. 'labels are learnable at 5s granularity', 'VIX 1-min is timely enough for the gate'). REQUIRED non-null for cross_review objections — the orchestrator drops untagged ones.

suggestion.description: Concrete fix the author could apply.

verification.description: The targeted verification actually performed (artifact-first → targeted tools, ADR-025 §4.3).

omission_probes.description: Coverage queries issued against the objective's key axes.

counter_evidence_queries.description: Searches that actively tried to falsify the headline recommendation.

n_dropped_out_of_domain.description: Set by the orchestrator on persisted cross-review artifacts: objections dropped by the interface-scope filter (untagged or self-declared out_of_domain).
